data.content_ref: inline:The target claims 11 pieces but its own countercondition admits the 11-piece maximum is impossible when all cuts pass through the exact center. Four distinct lines all passing through one common point are concurrent: every pairwise intersection coincides at that point, so the configuration has multiplicity 4, not the general-position requirement of distinct pairwise intersections. The lazy caterer's sequence R=(n²+n+2)/2 is only achievable when no three lines are concurrent; under the problem's forced concurrency the count is 2n=8. Thus the main claim contradicts the central-constraint geometry.
